qa.question: If the "when you use an Option card" effect triggers, what is the timing when it can activate?
qa.answer: It can be activated after activating the used Option card's [Main] effect.

qa.question: Does the "when you use an Option card" effect trigger if an Option card's effect activates by a method other than using the card?
qa.answer:
No, it doesn't trigger.
If an Option card's effect activates without using it, such as activation by a [Security] effect or <Delay>, the "when you use an Option card" effect doesn't trigger.

qa.question: During an attack by this card, I used the inherited effect on ST22-01 [Viximon] in this card's digivolution cards to digivolve it. Does this card's [End of Attack] inherited effect trigger at the end of the attack?
qa.answer: Yes, it triggers.

qa.question: ST22-04 [Taomon] with ST22-01 [Viximon] in digivolution cards attacks, and I use ST22-04 [Taomon]'s [When Attacking] effect to use an Option card. If I use ST22-01 [Viximon]'s inherited effect to digivolve this card at such times, can I activate this card's <Alliance>?
qa.answer:
No, you can't activate it.
<Alliance> is an effect that triggers upon an attack. In this case, ST22-04 [Taomon] attacks in its current state where this card's <Alliance> hasn't triggered, therefore it can't activate.

qa.question: After using this card's [When Moving] [On Play] effect to trash a card in my hand, can I choose to not return a card from my trash to the hand?
qa.answer: Yes, you can.

qa.question: What does "[When Digivolving] effects don't activate" mean, exactly?
qa.answer:
This effect prevents [When Digivolving] effects on cards from activating.
[When Digivolving] effects can no longer activate by triggering or when effects such as "activate that card's [When Digivolving]" effect" activate.

qa.question: I used a card affected by "can't activate [When Digivolving] effects" to attack. Can I activate that card's [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] effect at such times?
qa.answer:
Yes, you can.
The effect can activate if it activates upon the [When Attacking] timing.

qa.question: If a card is affected by "can't activate [When Digivolving] effects," can other effects activate its [When Digivolving] effect?
qa.answer: No, it can't be activated.

qa.question: If a card is affected by "can't activate [When Digivolving] effects," can I process just the "by" condition in its [When Digivolving] effect?
qa.answer: No, you can't.

qa.question: A card that was given "can't activate [When Digivolving] effects" digivolved into a card that has a [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] effect. Does that count as an instance of that effect's [X Per Turn] even if that effect can't be activated upon the timing when that card digivolved?
qa.answer:
No, it doesn't count.
The effect can't activate upon the [When Digivolving] timing, therefore it doesn't count as an instance of that effect's [X Per Turn].

qa.question: If I use this card's [When Attacking] effect to use an Option card from under a Tamer, what happens to that Option card?
qa.answer:
As with the standard rules, a used Option card is temporarily treated as not being in any area.
After using it and activating the Option card's [Main] effect, the card is trashed unless it's to be placed in an area.

qa.question: During an attack by this card, I used the inherited effect on ST22-01 [Viximon] in this card's digivolution cards to digivolve it. Does this card's [End of Attack] inherited effect trigger at the end of the attack?
qa.answer: Yes, it triggers.

qa.question: ST22-04 [Taomon] with ST22-01 [Viximon] in digivolution cards attacks, and I use ST22-04 [Taomon]'s [When Attacking] effect to use an Option card. If I use ST22-01 [Viximon]'s inherited effect to digivolve this card at such times, can I activate this card's <Alliance>?

<Alliance> is an effect that triggers upon an attack. In this case, ST22-04 [Taomon] attacks in its current state where this card's <Alliance> hasn't triggered, therefore it can't activate.

qa.question: I used this card's {Hand} [Counter] <Blast Digivolve> to digivolve my Digimon into this card during my opponent's counter timing, and I used its [When Digivolving] effect to play a [Pipe Fox] Token. At such times, can I use the [Pipe Fox] Token to block during the block timing?
qa.answer: Yes, you can.

qa.question: If I use this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] effect to use an Option card from under a Tamer, what happens to that Option card?
qa.answer: As with the standard rules, a used Option card is temporarily treated as not being in any area. After using it and activating the Option card's [Main] effect, the card is trashed unless it's to be placed in an area.

qa.question: If I use this card to attack and use its [When Attacking] effect to play a [Pipe Fox] Token, can I then use <Alliance> to suspend the [Pipe Fox] Token?
qa.answer: Yes, you can.

qa.question: ST22-04 [Taomon] with ST22-01 [Viximon] in digivolution cards attacks, and I use ST22-04 [Taomon]'s [When Attacking] effect to use an Option card. If I use ST22-01 [Viximon]'s inherited effect to digivolve this card at such times, can I activate this card's <Alliance>?
qa.answer:
No, you can't activate it.
<Alliance> is an effect that triggers upon an attack. In this case, ST22-04 [Taomon] attacks in its current state where this card's <Alliance> hasn't triggered, therefore it can't activate.

qa.question: If I use this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect to use an Option card from under a Tamer, what happens to that Option card?
qa.answer: As with the standard rules, a used Option card is temporarily treated as not being in any area. After using it and activating the Option card's [Main] effect, the card is trashed unless it's to be placed in an area.

qa.question: If the "when you use an Option card" effect triggers, what is the timing when it can activate?
qa.answer: It can be activated after activating the used Option card's [Main] effect.

qa.question: Does the "when you use an Option card" effect trigger if an Option card's effect activates by a method other than using the card?
qa.answer:
No, it doesn't trigger.
If an Option card's effect activates without using it, such as activation by a [Security] effect or <Delay>, the "when you use an Option card" effect doesn't trigger.

qa.question: In what order do a [Security] effect, "when [...] performs a security check" effect, and "when a card is removed from [...] security stack" effect activate when they trigger simultaneously upon a security check?
qa.answer:
[Security] effects take precedence for activation.
Upon a security check, a [Security] effect will immediately activate without pending activation.
For other triggered effects, the turn player activates their effects first.

qa.question: I tried to use this card's [All Turns] effect to place an opponent's Digimon as the bottom security card, but another effect prevented that Digimon from leaving. At such times, does this effect trash an opponent's security card?
qa.answer: No, it isn't trashed.

qa.question: I tried to use this card's [All Turns] effect to place an opponent's Digimon as the bottom security card, but another effect prevented that Digimon from leaving. At such times, does it count as a use of this effect's [Once Per Turn]?
qa.answer:
Yes, it counts. A use of [X Per Turn] occurs as soon as you choose to activate the effect.
In this case, a use of [Once Per Turn] occurs as soon as you choose to place an opponent's Digimon as the bottom security card.

qa.question: If an effect places a card under this card while it already has one or more cards under it, in what order do I place the cards?
qa.answer: You place it at the bottom of the cards.

qa.question: A level 5 [Taomon] attacks, and this card's [Your Turn] effect triggers. At such times, if another effect digivolves the attacking Digimon into a level 6 [Sakuyamon], what is the cost of the Option card that can be activated using this card's [Your Turn] effect?
qa.answer: 6 cost or less. The level of the attacking Digimon is referenced during the timing when this card's [Your Turn] effect activates.

qa.question: My Digimon with [Renamon], [Kyubimon], or [Sakuyamon] in its name attacks, and this card's [Your Turn] effect triggers. If another effect then digivolves the attacking Digimon and it no longer has [Renamon], [Kyubimon], or [Sakuyamon] in its name, can I still activate this effect?
qa.answer: Yes, you can.

qa.question: If I use this card's [Your Turn] effect to use an Option card from under this card, what happens to that Option card?
qa.answer: As with the standard rules, a used Option card is temporarily treated as not being in any area. After using it and activating the Option card's [Main] effect, the card is trashed unless it's to be placed in an area.

qa.question: This card is linked to a Digimon. If this card activates a link effect, is that effect considered a Digimon effect or an Option card effect?
qa.answer: It's considered a Digimon effect.

qa.question: Due to an effect, I can't use an Option card. Can I pay this card's link cost and link to one of my Digimon?
qa.answer:
Yes, you can link it.
Linking a card isn't the same as using an Option card, therefore a card can still get linked when you can't use Option cards.

qa.question: I used this card's [When Digivolving] effect to use ST22-08 [Offensive Plug-In V], and ST22-08 [Offensive Plug-In V]'s [Main] effect linked that card to a Digimon. What happens to "place the Option card used with this effect on top of your security stack face down instead of placing it in your trash" in this card's [When Digivolving] effect at such times?
qa.answer: ST22-08 [Offensive Plug-In V] can't be placed in the trash, therefore it can't be placed on top of the security stack.

qa.question: This card is linked to a Digimon. If this card activates a link effect, is that effect considered a Digimon effect or an Option card effect?
qa.answer: It's considered a Digimon effect.

qa.question: Due to an effect, I can't use an Option card. Can I pay this card's link cost and link to one of my Digimon?
qa.answer:
Yes, you can link it.
Linking a card isn't the same as using an Option card, therefore a card can still get linked when you can't use Option cards.

qa.question: If this card's 1st effect and a "when a card is removed from [...] security stack" effect trigger simultaneously when this card is trashed from the security stack, in what order do they activate?
qa.answer:
The turn player activates their effect first.
If both effects are the turn player's, they can activate them in any order.

qa.question: What is a {Security} effect?
qa.answer:
A {Security} effect can be triggered/activated while its card is face up in the security stack.
Such effects can't be triggered or activated in areas other than the face-up security cards.

qa.question: I have multiple copies of this card face-up in my security stack. When my Digimon with [Renamon], [Kyubimon], [Taomon], or [Sakuyamon] in its name would leave the battle area other than by battle, I activate the {Security} [All Turns] effect on the 1st copy of this card, and that Digimon is prevented from leaving. Can I then activate the {Security} [All Turns] effect on the 2nd copy of this card?
qa.answer:
Yes, you can.
The {Security} [All Turns] effects on the 2 copies of this card trigger simultaneously when your Digimon with [Renamon], [Kyubimon], [Taomon], or [Sakuyamon] in its name would leave the battle area other than by battle. After activating the effect on the 1st copy, the Digimon is prevented from leaving, then you can activate the {Security} [All Turns] effect on the 2nd copy of this card.
After that, the 1st effect on the 2 copies of this card will trigger simultaneously, and you can activate them one at a time for a total of 2 activations.

qa.question: I have this card placed face-up in my security stack. If this card's {Security} [All Turns] effect activates when multiples of my Digimon with [Renamon], [Kyubimon], [Taomon], or [Sakuyamon] in their names would leave the battle area other than by battle, then this card is trashed from the security stack, what happens?
qa.answer:
You choose 1 of your Digimon with [Renamon], [Kyubimon], [Taomon], or [Sakuyamon] in its name, and that Digimon is prevented from leaving the battle area.
If you have another face-up copy of this card in your security stack, the {Security} [All Turns] effects on those copies will also activate, and you can choose 1 more Digimon that will be prevented from leaving.

qa.question: This card is linked to a Digimon. If this card activates a link effect, is that effect considered a Digimon effect or an Option card effect?
qa.answer: It's considered a Digimon effect.

qa.question: Due to an effect, I can't use an Option card. Can I pay this card's link cost and link to one of my Digimon?
qa.answer:
Yes, you can link it.
Linking a card isn't the same as using an Option card, therefore a card can still get linked when you can't use Option cards.

qa.question: This card has 3 different cards in its App Fusion requirements. What combinations are possible for App Fusion?
qa.answer:
App Fusion is possible with the following combinations.
●[Gatchmon] with [Navimon] link card
●[Gatchmon] with [Tweetmon] link card
●[Navimon] with [Gatchmon] link card
●[Navimon] with [Tweetmon] link card
●[Tweetmon] with [Gatchmon] link card
●[Tweetmon] with [Navimon] link card

qa.question: Can I use this card's [When Attacking] effect to link a card that doesn't have <Link>?
qa.answer: No, you can't.

qa.question: I used this card's [When Attacking] effect to link BT21-018 [DoGatchmon]. At such times, can I use BT21-018 [DoGatchmon]'s link effect to attack?
qa.answer: No, you can't. A new attack declaration can't be made during an attack.

qa.question: This card attacks, and its <Raid> and [When Attacking] effect trigger simultaneously. Then, I first activate the [When Attacking] effect, link [Timemon], and I use BT21-084 [Haru Shinkai]'s [Your Turn] effect to app fuse to [Globemon]. After that, can I activate <Raid> on this card in digivolution cards?
qa.answer:
No, you can't.
<Raid> has already been lost, therefore it can't be activated.
However, when <Raid> and the [When Attacking] effect trigger simultaneously, you can activate <Raid> first and then activate the [When Attacking] effect.

qa.question: Can I use this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect to suspend either my Digimon or my opponent's Digimon?
qa.answer: Yes, either can be suspended.

qa.question: At the end of the turn, I used <Vortex> on this card to attack an opponent's Digimon, this Digimon was deleted in the battle, and I used <Fortitude> to play this card from the trash. At such times, can I again use <Vortex> to attack?
qa.answer:
No, you can't.
<Vortex> on this card triggers at the timing upon the end of the turn. If this card attacks using the triggered <Vortex> effect, is deleted in battle, and is played using <Fortitude>, the <Vortex> on this card hasn't triggered after being played, therefore it can't activate.

qa.question: My opponent has 5 cards in their hand and 5 cards in their trash. Can I activate this card's 1st effect and play it with the play cost reduced by 5?
qa.answer:
No, you can't.
This card's 1st effect activates when your opponent has 10 or more cards in their hand or 10 or more cards in their trash, then the play cost will be reduced by 5.
It doesn't activate when the total number of cards in their hand and trash is 10.

qa.question: My opponent has 10 cards in their hand and 10 cards in their trash. If I activate this card's 1st effect, what is the reduction to the play cost?
qa.answer:
The play cost is reduced by 5.
Even if they have 10 cards in their hand and 10 cards in their trash, the reduction to the play cost will be 5.

comprehensive-0223.title: <Blocker>
comprehensive-0223.text:
16-5. <Blocker>
16-5-1. <Blocker> is a keyword effect that applies a rule that allows a Digimon with that effect to block. (For details, refer to 12 "Blocking")
16-5-2. <Blocker> is a persistent effect. (For details, refer to 15-8-2 "Persistent Effects")
16-5-3. Even if 1 Digimon has multiple instances of <Blocker>, the number of blocks that can be performed during the block timing is only 1.

comprehensive-0226.title: <Draw>
comprehensive-0226.text:
16-8. <Draw>
16-8-1. <Draw> is a keyword effect where a player draws the cards from their deck according to the number specified in the effect. This is shown on cards using text such as <Draw 1>.
16-8-2. <Draw> effects execute processing.
16-8-3. A draw from <Draw> is mandatory.

comprehensive-0229.title: <Reboot>
comprehensive-0229.text:
16-11. <Reboot>
16-11-1. <Reboot> is a keyword effect where a Digimon with this effect is unsuspended during the opponent's unsuspend phase.
16-11-2. <Reboot> is a persistent effect. (For details, refer to 15-8-2 "Persistent Effects")
16-11-3. Even if 1 Digimon has multiple instances of <Reboot>, it is only unsuspended once during the opponent's unsuspend phase.
16-11-4. The unsuspending from <Reboot> is mandatory.
16-11-5. The unsuspending from <Reboot> is performed at the same time as the unsuspending of the turn player's Digimon. The unsuspends aren't performed in any particular order.

comprehensive-0230.title: <De-Digivolve>
comprehensive-0230.text:
16-12. <De-Digivolve>
16-12-1. <De-Digivolve> is a keyword effect where the player declares a number from 1 up to the number specified in the effect, then the declared number of cards are trashed from the chosen stack(s) of cards starting with the top card. This is shown on cards using text such as <De- Digivolve 1>.
16-12-2. <De-Digivolve> effects execute processing.
16-12-3. The trashing from <De-Digivolve> is mandatory. Once activated, a player can't choose to trash 0 cards.
16-12-4. <De-Digivolve> can't trash cards from level 3 cards or lower.
16-12-5. If multiple cards are trashed using 1 instance of <De- Digivolve>, all of the cards are considered to be trashed at the same time, but the procedure for trashing them is 1 card from the stack at a time.
16-12-6. When using <De-Digivolve> to trash multiple cards, even if the category of the top card changes while the trashing is still being performed, the trashing will continue until the declared number is trashed.
16-12-7. When separate instances of <De-Digivolve> are executed multiple times in a single effect, the processing is performed separately for each instance.
16-12-8. When separate instances of <De-Digivolve> are executed multiple times in a single effect, the state of the chosen card is confirmed after each single process for <De-Digivolve> ends. If an effect will be activated as a result of the confirmed state, it is then activated. (Example: When 3 instances of <De-Digivolve 1> are executed in a single effect, if the chosen card becomes an "unaffected by effects" card as a result of the 1st instance of <De-Digivolve 1>, that card is unaffected by the following instances of <De-Digivolve 1>.

comprehensive-0242.title: <Raid>
comprehensive-0242.text:
16-23. <Raid>
16-23-1. <Raid> is a keyword effect that can switch the target of attack to the opponent's unsuspended Digimon with the highest DP when a Digimon with this keyword effect attacks.
16-23-2. <Raid> is a trigger-type effect that triggers when a Digimon with this effect attacks. (For details, refer to 15-8-3 "Trigger-Type Effects")
16-23-3. The processing from <Raid> is optional.
16-23-4. If the opponent has multiple unsuspended Digimon with the highest DP when <Raid> activates, the player that activated the effect chooses a Digimon from among them and the attack target is switched to it.

comprehensive-0243.title: <Alliance>
comprehensive-0243.text:
16-24. <Alliance>
16-24-1. <Alliance> is a keyword effect. When a Digimon with this effect attacks, by suspending 1 of your other Digimon, add the suspended Digimon's DP to the attacking Digimon and it gains <Security A. +1> for the attack.
16-24-2. <Alliance> is a trigger-type effect that triggers when a Digimon with this effect attacks. (For details, refer to 15-8-3 "Trigger-Type Effects")
16-24-3. "By suspending 1 of your other Digimon" in <Alliance> is an optional processing condition. If the content of that condition is executed, the processing for "when a Digimon with this effect attacks, by suspending 1 of your other Digimon, add the suspended Digimon's DP to the attacking Digimon and it gains <Security A. +1> for the attack" will be mandatory.
16-24-4. The value added to DP by <Alliance> is the value of the suspended Digimon upon the suspension. The added DP from <Alliance> isn't modified, even if the DP of your suspended Digimon is later modified.
16-24-5. Even if your Digimon that was suspended by <Alliance> is removed from the battle area during the attack, the added DP and <Security A. +1> remain.

comprehensive-0244.title: <Barrier>
comprehensive-0244.text:
16-25. <Barrier>
16-25-1. <Barrier> is a keyword effect. When a Digimon with this effect would be deleted in battle, by trashing the top card of your security stack, this effect prevents that deletion.
16-25-2. <Barrier> is an immediate-type effect that triggers when the Digimon with this effect would be deleted in battle. (For details, refer to 15-8-5 "Immediate-Type Effects")
16-25-3. "By trashing the top card of your security stack" in <Barrier> is an optional processing condition. If the content of that condition is executed, the processing for "prevents the deletion" will be mandatory.

comprehensive-0245.title: <Blast Digivolve>
comprehensive-0245.text:
16-26. <Blast Digivolve>
16-26-1. <Blast Digivolve> is a keyword effect that allows one of your Digimon to digivolve into a card with this keyword effect in the hand without paying the cost.
16-26-2. <Blast Digivolve> effects execute processing.
16-26-3. The processing from <Blast Digivolve> is optional.
16-26-4. <Blast Digivolve> is an effect that digivolves the chosen Digimon in the battle area.

comprehensive-0246.title: <Fortitude>
comprehensive-0246.text:
16-27. <Fortitude>
16-27-1. <Fortitude> is a keyword effect. When a Digimon with digivolution cards and this effect is deleted, you play this Digimon without paying the cost.
16-27-2. <Fortitude> is a trigger-type effect that triggers when a Digimon with digivolution cards and this effect is deleted. (For details, refer to 15-8-3 "Trigger-Type Effects")
16-27-3. The processing from <Fortitude> is mandatory.

comprehensive-0252.title: <Vortex>
comprehensive-0252.text:
16-33. <Vortex>
16-33-1. <Vortex> allows the Digimon with this effect to attack an opponent's Digimon at the end of your turn. <Vortex> is a keyword effect that also allows a Digimon to attack in the same turn it was played.
16-33-2. <Vortex> is a trigger-type effect that triggers at the end of your turn. (For details, refer to 15-8-3 "Trigger-Type Effects")
16-33-3. The processing from <Vortex> is optional.
